title: Permit Inspection Hold on Window Contract Payoffs
content:
# Permit Inspection Hold on Window Contract Payoffs

Window Replacement Contracts. The inspection hold applies to a permitted installation job that is not yet closed, as shown on the contract's Installation Jobs record: such a job covering at least 15 units (the large-job unit count) holds the large inspection hold of $200; such a job covering fewer units holds the small inspection hold of $100; any other job holds nothing.

The job read is the contract's installation job that is not cancelled; "permitted" means the job is marked as requiring a permit, and the units are the job's unit count. The hold is taken from the job charges collected at payoff.

| Permit required | Job closed | Units on the job | Inspection hold |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 15 or more | $200 |
| Yes | No | 14 or fewer | $100 |
| Yes | Yes | Any | Nothing |
| No | Any | Any | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- Permitted job, completed but not closed, 16 units: $200.
- Permitted job, in progress, 15 units: $200; with 14 units: $100.
